units.axes: model space: +Y down, -Z is the front of the entity, -X is its right side
units.rotation: radians; a part applies Z, then Y, then X to its parent frame (a vertex is turned about X first)
units.position: pixels in model space; the authored up value is stored negated (Y down)
units.scale: stored as authored factor minus 1; channels add this value to the part scale
